name: Latin Leap Dealflow Automator
description: Scrapes LATAM startup sources, scores with Claude API, notifies Telegram if score >= threshold

trigger.description: Runs every weekday at 9am Bogota time

steps.note: Runs Mon-Fri at 9am. Change cron expression to adjust schedule.
Fetch recent YC companies from public API
Fetch trending startups from Product Hunt (LATAM filter)
Merge all sources into one list
Score each startup with Claude API
Send rich Telegram message with emoji, bullets, and scorecard

setup_instructions.1_import: En Pipedream ve a Workflows > Import > pega este JSON
setup_instructions.2_secrets: Configura estos secrets en cada paso: anthropic_api_key (paso score_with_claude), telegram_bot_token y telegram_chat_id (paso send_telegram)
setup_instructions.3_schedule: El workflow corre automaticamente lunes a viernes a las 9am hora Bogota
setup_instructions.4_threshold: Cambia THRESHOLD en el paso filter_by_threshold (default: 65)
setup_instructions.5_sources: Agrega tu token de ProductHunt en fetch_producthunt o conecta Apify para mas fuentes
